contracts.name: Chobariki, of the Shiny Muscles
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
You may put Chobariki in Support under any player's control.
As long as Chobariki is not under its owner's control:
  • When Chobariki loses a confrontation, its owner gains 10 Points;
  • When Chobariki wins a confrontation, it returns to the top of its owner's deck.
As long as Chobariki is in the Interzone, you may pay 🌿: It gains Support until the end of the turn.
printedClauses: Cannot be played as First Manifestation.

When Mamelath wins a confrontation, Exile it.
printedClauses: Cannot be played as First Manifestation.

contracts.name: Bibi, the Confused
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
You may put Bibi in Support under any player's control.
When Bibi enters the field, its Controller rolls a D6 and based on the result applies the following effects: If it is odd, a target card on the field you control other than Bibi loses its current effects until the end of the turn. If it is even, draw a card.
When Bibi wins a Confrontation, its Controller loses Points based on the result of the roll: 1 or 2 = -5 Points ; 3 or 4 = -10 Points ; 5 or 6 = -15 Points. Then Exile Bibi.
printedClauses: Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
